item.title: Core Keeper Mod Compatibility Checker — Find Mods for Your Build
item.description: Which Core Keeper mods work on your setup? This mod compatibility checker lets you filter the 22 most popular mods by platform and category, shows download counts, and points you to each mod’s official page to confirm compatibility against your exact game version (site baseline 1.3.0.6).
